description: This file defines the functionality for vertical tabs in a Drupal project, including behavior attachment, tab creation, focus management, and rendering.

classes.name: Drupal.verticalTab
classes.description: Represents a single vertical tab, managing focus, display, and summary updates.

methods.name: Drupal.verticalTab
methods.description: Constructor for a vertical tab object, initializes event handlers and state.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Displays the tab's content pane and updates UI state.

methods.name: tabShow
methods.description: Shows the vertical tab pane and updates markers.

methods.name: tabHide
methods.description: Hides the vertical tab pane and updates markers.
